title: feat(plugin-detail)!: the record page's related panels lose collapse; the header opens the whole list and empty panels fold into one line

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgQSrPxYRF6Q9RRD48Snj7Ks)_

Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no file under `skills/**` or `content/docs/**` teaches the related card's collapse, its `⋯` items or the stored arrangement (a `git grep` for each names nothing); what an author writes is unchanged.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:记录页右栏的关联列表变成同形面板。表头是「标题 + 数量」,点表头或数量打开整张列表;悬停时右端出现 ⠿ ＋ ⋯,⋯ 只剩「隐藏」;没有折叠、没有 ⤢。0 行的面板收成一行「还有 N 个空关联 · 名字 · … · 展开」。存储的排列去掉 `collapsed`(版本升到 2,旧记录读作「没选过」)。行内首列跳过指回本记录的外键。
- 为什么改:#27524 的 Target 1、2、10、11(画布 60 定稿),是四个串行 PR 中的第一个;3、12 在 main 上已成立,本 PR 只加钉子。
- 风险与回滚:只动 `@object-ui/plugin-detail`、十个语言包和 app-shell 的偏好编码;已拖过顺序的读者会回到默认顺序一次(无兼容读取,按裁定)。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/RelatedList.tsx`(紧凑面表头与首列);`RelatedListEmptyFold.tsx`(面板行的折叠规则);`synth/relatedArrangement.ts`(去掉 collapsed)。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/__tests__/RelatedPanel.header-27524.test.tsx packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-related-list.emptyPanels-27524.test.tsx`,预期 2 个文件、14 个测试全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

The record page's related column becomes a stack of same-shaped panels (record page v4, canvas 60). This is PR ① of four serial PRs for #27524, approved by the seat as a split; each leaves `main` coherent on its own.

| Target item | Where |
|---|---|
| 1 panel header | **this PR** (interim: the header opens the existing `?related=` face; PR ③ makes it the panel's tab) |
| 2 empty panels fold into one line | **this PR** |
| 3 column foot | already on `main` (`RelatedCardStack-27055` pins it); unchanged here |
| 10 stored arrangement without `collapsed` | **this PR** |
| 11 compact row's first column | **this PR** |
| 12 highlights = declared minus the name, max 6 | already on `main`; this PR adds the pin `highlights-27524.test.ts` |
| 4, 5, 6 ⊟ switch, 动态 as the first panel, tiers by container width | PR ② |
| 8, 9 the tab row, enlarged = active tab | PR ③ |
| 7 the top bar | PR ④ (with #27545's ⤢ / ⤡); the last PR, the one that closes the card |

**1. The panel header** (`RelatedList` compact face, `RelatedCardMenu.tsx`). Title, then the count chip, inside one `<button data-related-panel-open>` whose `title` reads 「查看全部 N 条」 (`detail.relatedPanelViewAll`); › shows at the title's end on hover or focus. The header row itself is the target too: the button's `::after` stretches over the positioned header, so a click on its free space opens the list while the row stays one control. The controls sit above it (`relative z-10`). On hover or focus-within the right end shows ⠿ (`RelatedPanelHandle`: the drag source on desktop; focused, ⌥↑ / ⌥↓ move the panel and keep focus on it), ＋ and ⋯, which holds 隐藏 only. No collapse, no ⤢, nothing reserved on the left. On a touch screen (`hover: none`) the controls stay drawn. The full face of an arranged list (the Related tab of an authored page) draws the same ⠿ and ⋯ and no longer collapses from its header.

The header has no click handler of its own, so a click inside the ⋯ menu's portaled content cannot open the list, even though it bubbles through React. The test `⋯ holds 隐藏 and nothing else` pins this. The first version, a clickable header `div` guarded by `event.currentTarget.contains(event.target)`, failed `clickableNonControlCensus-13461` in CI on `b8c4395be2`. `1d1d2d6e6f` replaces it with the stretched button. The census is red on `b8c4395be2` and green after the fix, locally.

**2. Empty panels** (`RelatedListEmptyFold.tsx`). In the panel column (`RelatedListCompactContext`) a stack of two or more folds its 0-row panels into one line after the others: 「还有 N 个空关联 · 名字 · … · 展开」 (`detail.relatedEmptyFold`, plural per pack; 展开 reuses `detail.relatedCardExpand`). Unlike the Related tab's line (#25895, unchanged), the panel line folds a panel with an `add` picker too, folds a column whose panels are all empty, and carries no New: 展开 draws the panels again in their places, each with its own ＋. Non-empty panels keep their order. 展开 holds for the record it was pressed on (`Stack.expandedFor`, `object:id` from the record context). A view that steps to another record in place, such as the pane's ↓ ↑, keeps its column element, and the next record folds again.

**10. The stored arrangement** (`synth/relatedArrangement.ts`, `useRelatedArrangement.ts`, app-shell `workspacePreference.ts`). `record.related.arrangement` is `{ v, order, hidden, basedOn, seen }`. `collapsed`, the `collapse` edit and the `defaultCollapsed` argument are removed; the codec's version is `RELATED_ARRANGEMENT_RECORD_VERSION` (2), so a version-1 record reads as no choice (no compatibility read, per the ruling). `CollapsedRelatedCard` and the stack's collapsed branch go.

**11. The compact row's first column** (`RelatedList`). When the child's name field is the FK pointing back at this record, the row is named by the first column that is not that FK, not redacted, not a platform column and readable. The authored columns are read first, then the declared fields. The FK is skipped even when it is the only authored column. So a product's line items name the opportunity.

**i18n.** `detail.relatedCardMoveUp`, `detail.relatedCardMoveDown`, `detail.relatedCardCollapse` and `detail.relatedCardCount` leave all ten packs; `detail.relatedPanelViewAll`, `detail.relatedPanelReorder`, `detail.relatedPanelReorderHint` and `detail.relatedEmptyFold` arrive in all ten, with each pack's plural set.

**Declared.** `Clause-②: yes (narrowing)`: `RelatedArrangement`, `ResolvedRelatedArrangement` and `RelatedArrangementEdit` are exported from the plugin-detail entry and lose members. `@object-ui/i18n`'s exported `TranslationKeys` (`typeof en`) also loses the four removed keys. A `t()` call naming one still compiles, because its key parameter is a `string`. The changeset's BREAKING banner names both packages. Its ADR-0087 marker, `not-required (runtime-interface-only …)`, names all four symbols, and the gate verifies it. The changeset also carries the one-line fix. `RELATED_ARRANGEMENT_RECORD_VERSION` is a new export.

**Source re-measured (main `273137d227` → this branch's base).** S1, S3 and S4 hold. S2 drifted, description only: the page's crumb row carries ‹ back and 「收为抽屉」, with no ↑ ↓. The card names `synth/recordTimelineStream.ts`; the file is `src/recordTimelineStream.ts`, and the promotion logic it means lives in `synth/recordPageColumns.ts` (PR ② retires it there). Neither drift changes what a Target item asks.

**File surface.** One file outside the card's list: `ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/workspacePreference.ts`, the codec of `record.related.arrangement` (item 10 cannot land without its version). `RelatedList.tsx`, `RelatedCardMenu.tsx`, `relatedListCompact.ts`, `renderers/record-related-list.tsx` and `index.tsx` are the files the header and fold are drawn in, beside the listed ones.

## Tests

New:

- `__tests__/RelatedPanel.header-27524.test.tsx` (10): the real `RelatedList` compact face with the stack's chrome. Header anatomy (title, chip, no toggle, no ⤢, 「View all 2」); row, title and chip each open the list; ⠿ ＋ ⋯ at the right end, hover/focus classes, their clicks do not open the list; ⋯ holds Hide only and Hide does not open the list; ⌥↑ / ⌥↓ on the handle, a bare arrow does nothing; the handle is the drag source, the header row is not; the first column on the product page (`Acme renewal`, `Globex pilot`), also when the FK is the only authored column, and on the opportunity page (`Widget`); the arranged full face (the Related tab) draws ⠿ and ⋯, no chevron, and a header click leaves its rows drawn.
- `renderers/__tests__/record-related-list.emptyPanels-27524.test.tsx` (4): the line's text and order; 展开 restores the panels in place; stepping to a sibling record in the same view (same column element) folds again; an all-empty column folds.
- `synth/__tests__/highlights-27524.test.ts` (3): lead and contact sets minus `full_name`, the cut at six.
- `app-shell/src/utils/workspacePreference.relatedArrangement-27524.test.ts` (2): the v2 shape round-trips; a v1 record carrying `collapsed` reads as no choice.

Updated, not deleted: `RelatedCardStack-27055` (the collapse case becomes "a panel has no collapse"; moves via the handle), `relatedArrangement-27055` (collapse cases become order + hidden), `RelatedList.compactColumn-26678` (the new header anatomy).

The one red was `⋯ holds 隐藏 and nothing else` reading a `RelatedList.tsx` transformed before the commit below landed mid-run (it asserts that commit's class). - A bug the screenshots found, fixed in `b8c4395be2`: with ⋯ open the controls faded out, because the pointer and the focus are both inside the portaled menu. The controls now stay drawn while a control holds `data-state=open`; the menu test pins it.
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, wrap mode, on `e8a0e9f9fd`): in `RelatedListEmptyFold.tsx`, `if (!panels && !ordered.some((m) => m.empty === false)) return NO_FOLD;` → `if (!ordered.some((m) => m.empty === false)) return NO_FOLD; /* ABLATED_27524 */` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `cfb2543146ea` → `e4a7af3d6923`, marker count 1). Red: `a column whose panels are all empty folds them too` (`Tests 1 failed | 2 passed (3)`); the two cases with a non-empty panel stay green, as they should. Restored: blob equal to HEAD's, `git diff HEAD` empty. The suite imports the renderer from source, so no `dist` is involved.

- Contract review 6514756946 (FAIL on `b8c4395be2`), fixed in `8b20d10d4c`. Each pin was ablated (`ablation-replace.mjs`, wrap mode) and restored:
  - ④-1: 展开 scoped to the record. Ablation `stack?.expandedFor === recordKey` → `stack?.expandedFor != null`. Result: the sibling case is red, `Tests 1 failed | 3 passed (4)`.
  - ④-2: the first column falls through to the declared fields. Ablation `[...authored, ...declared]` → `(authored.length > 0 ? authored : declared)`. Result: the authored-only case is red, `Tests 1 failed | 9 passed (10)`.
  - ④-3: the Related tab list no longer collapses. Ablation: `arrangedFull` put back into `isCollapsible`. Result: the full-face case is red, `Tests 1 failed | 9 passed (10)`.
  - ②-1: the changeset banner names `@object-ui/i18n`, and the marker adds `ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts#TranslationKeys`. `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`: exit 0, four symbols verified.
- On `8b20d10d4c`: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView packages/components/src/__tests__/clickableNonControlCensus-13461.test.ts` under the lock → `Test Files 425 passed | 1 skipped (426)`, `Tests 3635 passed | 18 skipped (3653)`; `@object-ui/plugin-detail` type-check VERDICT command-exit 0; eslint on the four touched files 0 errors.
- Proxy preview review 6521198256 (REWORK on `8b20d10d4c`, Target 1: a press on the header row's free space opened nothing), fixed in `e6436ddc12`. The open button carries `transform: none`, so the console's pressed-button `scale(0.96)` no longer makes it the containing block of its stretched `::after`. On `e6436ddc12`, under the lock: `RelatedPanel.header-27524`, `RelatedList.compactColumn-26678`, `RelatedCardStack-27055`, `clickableNonControlCensus-13461` → `Test Files 4 passed (4)`, `Tests 33 passed (33)`; `@object-ui/plugin-detail` type-check VERDICT command-exit 0; eslint on the two touched files 0 errors. Ablation (the `style={{ transform: 'none' }}` line replaced by `/* ABLATED_27920 */` with `sed`, marker count 1): the pin is red (`expected '' to be 'none'`, `Tests 1 failed | 9 passed (10)`), and a live press on the free space (Playwright, 120 ms hold, an app-crm account at 1440) opens nothing. Restored with `git checkout`: `git diff HEAD` empty, and the same press opens `?related=crm_activity.account`.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Screenshots: on `examples/app-crm`, not HotCRM (deviation, as the order says); six shots in `/mnt/project-files/ui-seat2/card-27524/shots/` (project files, not a repository branch), zh, 1440 × 900, on the final head through the console's dev server: `01-account-1440-panels` (three panels with rows, then 「还有 1 个空关联 · 线索列表 · 展开」), `02-panel-header-hover` (›, ⠿ ＋ ⋯), `03-panel-menu-hide-only`, `04-empty-panels-expanded`, `05-header-click-opens-list` (the interim `?related=` face), `06-opportunity-1440` (all three panels empty → one line). The tier, the 时间线 | 关联 control and the folded 动态 card in them are `main`'s and change in PR ② and ④. app-crm has no product object, so Target 11 is shown by its test only.
- The panel fold line needs a stack of at least two panels; a single empty panel stays drawn.
- The epic seat verifies in the console preview against the boards before ACCEPT.
